newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Flughafen Wien raised to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Flughafen Wien raised to "buy".

text.p: Brokerage IMI Sigeco said on Wednesday it had upgraded shares in Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien to "buy" from "hold" based on expectations of strong passenger numbers and retail income.
In a statement, IMI Sigeco said it considered 550 schillings per share a "fair value price". Flughafen was trading 14 schillings up at 539 in Vienna at midday.
IMI Sigeco said Flughafen Wien provided a convincing case for growth in both passenger numbers and retail income.

It forecast passenger numbers would increase an average 7.2 percent yearly from 1996 to 2000. Non-aviation income was expected to grow at an annual average of 10.4 percent over the same period and aviation income at 2.8 percent.
IMI Sigeco estimated earnings per share at 32 schillings this year, rising to 41 schillings by 2000.

It added that although half-year traffic figures were below expectations this year, growth should accelerate in the second half, with the third quarter the strongest. -- Michael Gray, Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
